SSF · MS7 · MS Math 7th · Mystery Case File · Immigrant & Refugee Journeys

THE DIRECTIONS

You will talk to four people. Record what you would say to each one. You can record again as many times as you want. When all four are recorded, click Submit.

The first time you press record, your computer will ask to use your microphone. Click Allow.

The count sheet

THE SCENE

A family brought an old photo to the history room. No name is written on it, only one ship: the Aurania. You are alone with a box of twelve hundred name cards. You must guess how many cards show that ship. Four people can each help you.

THE HISTORY

The cards in your box come from old ship lists. Ellis Island opened in New York in 1892. Twelve million people came through it in sixty years. Families still read those lists to find their own names.
